name: Yumeno Akika
source:
[Spoiler]Sickness: 

Timophilia: Arousal and intense attraction to gold, wealth, and material status. 

Necrophilia: A psychological and sexual disorder in which an individual experiences sexual attraction to human corpses. 

She's an individual who's willing to put people's lives on the line to gain sexual satisfaction. 

She doesn't speak much and shows little to no emotion.

[Based on the in-game profile] 

She's the actress who plays [url=/c102769]Amashiro Sumera[/url] and is one of the few survivors from the 'incident'.[/spoiler]
